noInstall.question: Do I need to install any software?
noInstall.answer: No. ISPC Fácil is a 100% web-based platform. All you need is internet access to issue invoices on any device, whether a computer, tablet or smartphone.

ispcUpToDate.question: Is the ISPC calculation up to date?
ispcUpToDate.answer: Yes. We keep ISPC rates and categories up to date in line with current Mozambican regulations.

freeTrial.question: Can I try it before paying?
freeTrial.answer: Absolutely. We offer a 14-day free trial, with no credit card required.

dataSecurity.question: Is my data secure?
dataSecurity.answer: Yes. We use end-to-end SSL/TLS encryption, automatic backups and data security best practices.

cancelAnytime.question: Can I cancel at any time?
cancelAnytime.answer: Yes, with no commitment. You can cancel your subscription at any time, with no additional fees.

localSupport.question: Is support available in Mozambican Portuguese?
localSupport.answer: Yes. Our support team is Mozambican and available in Mozambican Portuguese by email, chat and WhatsApp.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: The rules for using ISPC Fácil safely and transparently.
terms.intro: By creating an account or using ISPC Fácil, you confirm that you have read and accept these terms of use.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of the terms
acceptance.content: These terms govern access to and use of the ISPC Fácil platform. If you do not agree with any condition, you should not use the service.

service.title: 2. Description of the service
service.content: ISPC Fácil is a tool that supports invoicing, financial management and ISPC calculation for entrepreneurs and businesses in Mozambique.

userResponsibilities.title: 3. User responsibilities
userResponsibilities.content: The user undertakes to provide true and up-to-date information, to protect their credentials and to use the platform in accordance with applicable law.

liability.title: 4. Limitation of liability
liability.content: The platform is a support tool. Final responsibility for the accuracy of information, invoices, tax returns and payments lies with the user.

changes.title: 5. Availability and changes
changes.content: We may update, improve or change features of the service. We may also update these terms, communicating relevant changes through the platform.

contact.title: 6. Contact
contact.content: For questions about these terms or the use of the service, please use the contact channels provided on the platform.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How ISPC Fácil collects, uses and protects your data.
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy clearly explains what data we collect and the purposes for which we use it.

dataCollected.title: 1. Data we collect
dataCollected.content: We may collect your name, email address, phone number and information about your company when you create an account, use the platform or contact us.

dataUse.title: 2. How we use your data
dataUse.content: We use this information to provide the invoicing services, calculate ISPC, manage your account, provide support and communicate important information about the service.

protection.title: 3. Protection and retention
protection.content: We apply technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, alteration or disclosure. We keep data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described and applicable legal obligations.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing of information
sharing.content: We do not sell your personal data. We only share it with providers essential to the operation of the platform or when required by law, including by the competent authorities.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
rights.content: You may request access to, rectification or deletion of your data, and ask any questions about this policy, through the contact channels provided on the platform.
